title: Deadliest Houthi-Government Escalation Since 2022 Truce Kills 30+ Soldiers; Grundberg Warns of Renewed Large-Scale War
detail: August 6-7, 2026 — Houthi missile and drone strikes launched from al-Jawf killed more than 30 government soldiers in Hadramout and Marib, while a strike on Najran, Saudi Arabia, wounded 11 civilians including a child; 12 or more further missile attacks followed on August 7. UN Special Envoy Hans Grundberg said Yemen 'faces a greater risk of renewed large-scale conflict than at any point since the UN-brokered truce of April 2022' and called for maximum restraint and UN-led negotiations. The escalation traced back to a July 13 Yemeni government strike on Sanaa airport intended to block an Iranian flight, which triggered a spiraling Houthi-Saudi confrontation.

title: Venezuela Government-Opposition Democracy Talks Formally Begin in Caracas
detail: August 6-7, 2026 — Venezuela's US-backed democracy talks formally began in Caracas, with a government delegation led by National Assembly President Jorge Rodríguez and an opposition bloc led by Dinorah Figuera, a former 2015 National Assembly member who returned from Spanish exile in June. Sessions were set to run continuously through August 12, when continuation would be assessed, with the broader process expected to extend to December 2026.
